title: CoreProtect
what: Remembers who placed or broke every block, so you can see who griefed and put it back.
steps: In the game, /co inspect (or /co i) turns on the inspector: click a block to see its history.
Look up a player to see what they changed, then roll it back if it was griefing.
A rollback can be taken back with Undo the last rollback.
The history grows over time; Delete old history keeps the database small.

buttons.label: Roll back a player's changes
buttons.warning: Blocks in the whole world go back to how they were. Undo the last rollback takes it back.

buttons.label: Undo the last rollback
buttons.warning: This puts the rolled-back blocks back.

buttons.label: Delete old history
buttons.warning: Older history is deleted for good, so it can't be looked up or rolled back.
